subject: ZetaEdge — request for multi-year price guard + uplift cap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ZetaEdge — request for multi-year price guard + uplift cap

Team — quick escalation for approval. ZetaEdge (prospect turning into a large pilot/customer) is requesting a 3-year commitment with the following non-standard commercial asks: a 24-month price lock on unit pricing, an annual uplift cap at 6% (regardless of cloud cost moves), and an automatic renewal protection clause that limits renewal increases to either CPI or the uplift cap — whichever is lower.

TL;DR: Opportunity is meaningful — $4.2M ARR year 1 with 30% expected growth across the committed years if they convert. They're pushing for these protections to get internal board approval. They want our commercial language and an executive sign-off to proceed.

What's attached: ZetaEdge_TermSheet_v2.pdf (redline), price_model_v3.xlsx (unit economics), ZEDGE_SOW_draft.docx (scope).

Asks: 1) Exec approval to accept a 24-month hard price lock and 6% annual uplift cap; 2) Approval to include a renewal-protection clause limiting renewal increases as described; 3) If no, direction on acceptable guardrails (e.g., 12–18 month lock, uplift cap 8–10%).

Customer urgency: Asha (their procurement) needs our approved commercial term sheet for board review by Friday.

Notes/risk: Mina — will need Legal to bless the renewal language and add audit/usage reconciliation language. Marcus — impact on long-term unit economics if we cap uplift at 6%.

Thanks — Jordan

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0147
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ZetaEdge — request for multi-year price guard + uplift cap

Jordan — thanks for the summary. I support providing commercial flexibility here but we need strict guardrails. Two immediate concerns: 1) a 24-month hard lock removes our flexibility to pass through significant infra cost increases — we should require a pass-through trigger for GPU cost deltas >20%; 2) the renewal-protection clause must include an audit window and a right to renegotiate if usage shifts materially (>35%).

If Legal signs off, I can approve a 24-month lock + 6% uplift cap provided we put in these exceptions. Also recommend a mid-term pricing review (month 18) with a scheduled executive touchpoint.

Attaching a suggested paragraph to the term sheet (see inline in ZetaEdge_TermSheet_v2.pdf).

-Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ZetaEdge — request for multi-year price guard + uplift cap

Quick math: with the current price_model_v3.xlsx assumptions the 6% cap pushes our expected margin below target in year 3 if infra inflation is 12% p.a. We should consider one of the following: 1) maintain 24-month lock but set uplift cap at 8% with a hard pass-through for core infra increases over X% (I can model X); 2) offer a 12-month lock with a guaranteed right to renew at an indexed price to reflect cost changes.

Recommendation: approve a 24-month lock with a 6% cap only if we insert a cloud-cost pass-through trigger at >15% and a negotiation clause at renewal if usage grows >25%. Otherwise propose 8% cap.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 06 Dec 2028 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ZetaEdge — request for multi-year price guard + uplift cap

Thanks — incorporated Marcus and Marissa feedback into the attached TermSheet_v2 (redline) and the price model. Key changes: added pass-through for cloud infra cost increases >15%, renewal negotiation trigger at usage delta >25%, and a mid-term executive review at month 18. I also added language to limit renewal increases to the lower of CPI or the uplift cap, and a carve-out for any mandatory regulation-driven cost increases.

Customer update: Asha called — board window moved up to Thursday EOD. They've said this is the final commercial hurdle. I'm pushing Legal for an expedited review but need an exec sign-off to show to the customer.

Linked: HubSpot deal and the DocuSign starter packet (see related_links).

-Jordan

Appreciate the clear path and the risk mitigations. I approve the following commercially: a 24-month price lock, a 6% annual uplift cap, pass-through for cloud infra cost increases >15%, renewal negotiation trigger at >25% usage variance, and an executive mid-term review at month 18.

Conditions: 1) Legal (Mina) must finalize wording to preserve our audit and termination rights; 2) Finance to validate the price_model_v3.xlsx with stress scenarios (Marcus); 3) Deal must include a 9-month payment cadence (no annual prepay at this discount level).

Jordan — please capture these conditions in a final term sheet and route to Mina and Finance before sending to the customer. Once Legal signs, you have my sign-off to proceed to DocuSign.

-Laura
